reasons: Not seat-rotated. Forge's seat bias is large (seat 1 wins ~11%, seat 4 ~36%), so these win rates measure seating as much as decks.

combos.description:
Activate Peregrin Took by sacrificing three Foods.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers three times, creating three tapped Treasure and three tapped Food tokens.
Resolve the Peregrin Took ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control at least three Foods.

combos.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Food, adding {C}{C}.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control at least one Food.

combos.description:
Activate Nuka-Cola Vending Machine by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Clue, untapping Nuka-Cola Vending Machine.
Repeat.

Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Food.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
When the tokens enter the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers three times, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You control at least one Food.

produces: Infinite mana artifacts you control can produce
Infinite untap of artifacts you control
combos.description:
Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating a Clue, a Food and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two of the tokens, untapping Transmutation Font.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens, you may produce Blood tokens using Transmutation Font instead.

Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and your choice of a Clue, Food or Blood artifact token
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Transmutation Font.
Repeat.

Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating your choice of a Clue, Food or Blood artifact token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station,
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the token and Grinding Station, untapping Transmutation Font.
Repeat.

Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating a Clue, Food of Blood token and an additional Food token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Transmutation Font.
Repeat.

Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat.

Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {3}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Basalt Monolith's last ability.
Resolve the copy of Basalt Monolith's last ability, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Basalt Monolith ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

produces: Put all Equipment cards from your library onto the battlefield
combos.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Godo with haste.
The token Godo enters the battlefield, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Declare the token Godo as an attacker.
The token Godo triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
combos.prerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Godo.

Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Metalworker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: Metalworker does not have summoning sickness. You have at least three artifact cards in hand.

Forsaken Monument triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Thran Dynamo.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Thran Dynamo.

Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.

combos.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Flare of Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, copying Flare of Duplication targeting the spell cast in step 1 and returning the original Flare of Duplication to your hand.
Cast Flare of Duplication by paying its mana cost, copying the copy of Flare of Duplication, targeting the copy of Flare of Duplication.
Resolve the copy of Flare of Duplication, creating a copy of Flare of Duplication targeting the copy of Flare of Duplication.
Repeat step 5.
combos.mana_needed: {1}{U}{U}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery at most

combos.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard for its escape cost by exiling three cards besides Brain Freeze from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Cast Brain Freeze either from your hand by paying {1}{U}, or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Brain Freeze's storm ability triggers, creating at least two copies of Brain Freeze targeting yourself, and any remaining copies targeting an opponent.
Resolve each Brain Freeze, causing yourself to mill nine cards and, if applicable, an opponent to mill three cards for each Brain Freeze remaining.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You have at least six other cards in your graveyard, plus an additional four cards if Brain Freeze is in your graveyard.

combos.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard for its escape cost by exiling three cards besides Brain Freeze from your graveyard.
Cast Brain Freeze from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Brain Freeze's storm ability triggers, creating at least one copy of Brain Freeze targeting yourself, and any remaining copies targeting an opponent.
Resolve each Brain Freeze, causing yourself to mill six cards and, if applicable, an opponent to mill three cards for each Brain Freeze remaining.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You have at least six other cards in hand and/or graveyard.

combos.description:
Cast Jeska's Will from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, adding at least six {R}.
Cast Wheel of Fortune from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing each player to discard their hand and draw seven cards.
Repeat.
combos.prerequisites:
You have at least six additional cards in your graveyard, plus an additional six cards between your hand and/or graveyard.
An opponent has at least six cards in hand.

combos.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Wheel of Fortune from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{R} and exiling 3 cards from your graveyard.
Resolve Wheel of Fortune, causing each player to discard their hand and draw seven cards.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard for its escape cost by exiling 3 cards from your graveyard.
 Repeat.
combos.prerequisites: You have at least six other cards in hand and/or graveyard.
